title: KAP Key Delivery Message
description: Normative JSON Schema for S4 – KAP Key Delivery Message Schema of the KAPRI Specification Suite.
$comment: This schema references the common data types defined by SC1 – Common Data Types.

schema_version.description: SC1 §4.3 Schema Version. Version of the referenced KAP Key Delivery Message schema.

kdm_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the KAP Key Delivery Message.

package_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Identifies the referenced Knowledge Asset Package.

recipient_certificate.description: Identifies the Recipient Certificate whose public key was used to encrypt the File Keys.

key_entries.description: Collection of recipient-specific Encrypted File Keys.

organization.description: SC1 §4.4 Organization. Intended recipient of the KAP Key Delivery Message.

organization_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the recipient organization.

name.description: Human-readable name of the recipient organization.

certificate_reference.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Identifies and embeds an X.509 certificate.

certificate_id.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Stable identifier of the certificate.

subject.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Subject Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

issuer.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Issuer Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

serial_number.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Certificate serial number represented as a decimal string.

certificate.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. DER-encoded X.509 certificate using Base64 according to RFC 4648 Section 4 with padding.

key_entry.description: Structure defined by S4 §3.1 Structure. Associates one Key Identifier with one recipient-specific Encrypted File Key.

key_id.description: SC1 §4.15 Key Identifier. Identifies the symmetric File Key.

encrypted_file_key.description: SC1 §4.14 Encrypted File Key. Recipient-specific encrypted representation of the symmetric File Key.

signature.description: SC1 §4.12 Signature. Digital signature protecting the KAP Key Delivery Message.

certificate_chain.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference[]. Ordered leaf-to-root and self-contained.

certificate_id.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Stable identifier of the certificate.

subject.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Subject Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

issuer.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Issuer Distinguished Name in RFC 4514 string form.

serial_number.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. Certificate serial number represented as a decimal string.

certificate.description: SC1 §4.13 Certificate Reference. DER-encoded X.509 certificate using Base64 according to RFC 4648 Section 4 with padding.

signature_value.description: Digital signature over the canonical representation of the KAP Key Delivery Message.
